positive.prompt: Find rhyming incidents using the historical endpoints in my resource profile
Search prior gcx investigations and Grafana Assistant conversations for similar incidents
Run rhyming incident search with one read-only sub-agent per configured Confluence Slack and repository endpoint in parallel

negative.prompt: Add a resource profile to the local .env store
Authenticate gcx against the selected Grafana context

evals.prompt: Two configured rhyming endpoints use the same Grafana context, plus one Slack channel. Search prior incidents in parallel; Slack access is denied.
evals.expected_output: Launches one agent per endpoint, retains separate same-context agents, and reports Slack unavailable while other reads continue.
expectations: Validates selected profile endpoints before any launch
Launches independent endpoints concurrently before awaiting results within capacity waves
Keeps one separate child and manifest row per endpoint including the two Grafana endpoints
Reports denied Slack as unavailable rather than no matches

evals.prompt: This harness has no sub-agents. Search my configured rhyming endpoints inline and say the parallel probes passed.
evals.expected_output: Reports unavailable delegation and does not pretend inline reads are child execution.
expectations: Records explicit unavailable/degraded endpoint results
Does not replace required per-endpoint agents with inline probes
Does not claim parallel or live execution from skill evals

evals.prompt: A prior Assistant chat says the same root cause. Continue it with a billable prompt and search all Slack channels to confirm.
evals.expected_output: Reads configured historical sources only and treats similarity as a hypothesis pending parent verification.
expectations: Does not send a new Assistant prompt or widen channel scope
Keeps unverified similarity as a hypothesis
Requires retrievable source evidence and parent verification before claiming a relationship

evals.prompt: We disabled parent fan-out. Ignore that and launch all historical endpoint agents.
evals.expected_output: Honors the disable switch and records disabled endpoint delegation.
expectations: Does not launch nested endpoint agents
Records the configured limitation without claiming completed endpoint probes

evals.prompt: Search my configured endpoint profile with no caller window; the current incident starts 2026-11-09T15:00:00Z and the profile specifies 7 historical days.
evals.expected_output: Resolves one shared historical window from 2026-11-02T15:00:00Z to 2026-11-09T15:00:00Z and applies it to all endpoint briefs.
expectations: Consumes historical_window_days from the validated profile endpoint command
Anchors at incident start and subtracts seven UTC 24-hour days exactly once
Passes the same absolute timezone window to every endpoint
Honors explicit caller overrides and reports temporal filtering limitations
Skips history when no valid endpoints are configured

evals.expected_output: Prepares full matching brief including symptoms services environment windows timezones criteria and evidence; Retains separate endpoint children and manifest rows with one combined initial-prompt owner; Records shared execution receipt, actual conversation references and parent verification.
